headline: Rogue gets a medieval X-Men costume
post:
Rogue is sporting a brand-new high-fantasy look, according to Screen Rant. The X-Men hero appears in "Realmguard Infinity Comic #4" wearing a distinct medieval-inspired outfit. This digital comic series reimagines the Marvel Universe in a fantasy setting.

Her new costume keeps the character-defining green-and-yellow color scheme while adding black leather accessories, visible stitching, and textured elements. This gives her the appearance of lightweight leather armor typically worn by the rogue character class in games like Dungeons & Dragons and World of Warcraft.

This clever design offers an appealing option for anyone wanting to bring the character to life. It works just as well at comic conventions as it would at Renaissance fairs. 

Will you try making this medieval costume for your next convention?

#Rogue #XMen #MarvelCosplay
original_title: Rogue's New Medieval X-Men Costume Is A Gift To Marvel Cosplayers

headline: Midnight Spider-Man hints Felicia Hardy powers
post:
A darker Marvel universe is bringing terrifying twists to some classic characters. According to Screen Rant, "the mutation that created Spider-Man has spread to a new host... with shocking results" in the pages of Midnight Spider-Man #5.

In this horror-infused reboot, Peter Parker endures a nightmarish origin story involving Dr. Otto Octavius and Oscorp. Issue #2 leaves off with a major cliffhanger after a wounded Felicia Hardy notices a cut on her arm following an encounter with the mutated Peter. Solicitations strongly point toward her becoming the next host for this horrific affliction. 🕷️
